"""
RAG Scene 01 — Chess: FEN position + animated moves
Feature: Board.set_board_from_FEN, move_piece with animation
"""
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board, Rook, Queen

class ChessFENAndMovesScene(Scene):
    """
    Displays a famous endgame position loaded from FEN, plays two animated
    moves, and annotates the board state with native Manim elements.
    """

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#1a1a2e"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Chess Endgame: Rook vs Queen", font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        subtitle = Text("Lucena Position — White to move", font_size=20, color="#94a3b8")
        header = VGroup(title, subtitle).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Board: Lucena-like endgame FEN ───────────────────────────────────
        # Queen endgame: white king on e6, white rook on a8, black king on e8, black rook on d1
        FEN = "4k3/8/4K3/8/8/8/8/R7 w - - 0 1"
        board = Board()
        board.set_board_from_FEN(FEN)
        board.scale(0.9).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.3)

        self.play(FadeIn(board), run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.5)

        # ── Step label utility ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        def show_step(text_str, color="#F59E0B"):
            lbl = Text(text_str, font_size=22, color=color)
            lbl.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.35)
            return lbl

        # ── Move 1: Rook a8 → a1 (animated) ──────────────────────────────
        step1 = show_step("1. Ra1  — Rook cuts off the king")
        self.play(Write(step1), run_time=0.6)
        anim1 = board.move_piece("a1", "a5", instant=False)
        self.play(anim1, run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.4)
        self.play(FadeOut(step1), run_time=0.3)

        # ── Move 2: Rook a5 → e5 (animated) ──────────────────────────────
        step2 = show_step("2. Re5  — Rook to 5th rank check zone")
        self.play(Write(step2), run_time=0.6)
        anim2 = board.move_piece("a5", "e5", instant=False)
        self.play(anim2, run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.4)
        self.play(FadeOut(step2), run_time=0.3)

        # ── Move 3: Rook e5 → e8 checkmate illustration ─────────────────────
        step3 = show_step("3. Re8#  — Checkmate!", color="#10B981")
        self.play(Write(step3), run_time=0.6)
        anim3 = board.move_piece("e5", "e8", instant=False)
        self.play(anim3, run_time=1.2)
        self.wait(0.5)

        result_box.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN * 0.5)

        self.play(FadeIn(VGroup(result_box, border)), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1.2)

"""
RAG Scene 02 — Chess: Famous opening (Ruy Lopez / Spanish Game) via PGN
Feature: convert_from_PGN, play_game with animation_time
"""
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board, convert_from_PGN, play_game

class ChessRuyLopezScene(Scene):
    """
    Plays the first 8 moves of the Ruy Lopez (Spanish Game) opening,
    loaded from PGN notation.  Annotates each phase with a native Manim
    Text label and highlights the key bishop development move.
    """

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0d1117"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Ruy López Opening", font_size=38, color=WHITE)
        subtitle = Text("The Spanish Game — one of the oldest openings", font_size=18, color="#8b949e")
        header = VGroup(title, subtitle).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.18)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.7)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Board ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        FEN = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"
        board = Board()
        board.set_board_from_FEN(FEN)
        board.scale(0.88).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.3)

        self.play(FadeIn(board), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Phase labels ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
        def phase_label(text_str, color="#F59E0B"):
            lbl = Text(text_str, font_size=20, color=color)
            lbl.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.35)
            return lbl

        # ── Phase 1: e4 e5 Nf3 — King-pawn opening ─────────────────────────
        lbl1 = phase_label("Phase 1: King-pawn opening — 1.e4 e5 2.Nf3")
        self.play(Write(lbl1), run_time=0.5)

        pgn_phase1 = """1. e4 e5 2. Nf3"""
        moves1 = convert_from_PGN(pgn_phase1, FEN=FEN)
        play_game(scene=self, board=board, moves=moves1, animation_time=0.6)
        self.wait(0.4)
        self.play(FadeOut(lbl1), run_time=0.3)

        # Track FEN after phase 1 (compute manually for simplicity via known position)
        FEN2 = "r1bqkbnr/pppp1ppp/2n5/4p3/4P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKB1R w KQkq - 2 3"

        # ── Phase 2: Nc3 Nc6 Bb5 — The Spanish bishop ──────────────────────
        lbl2 = phase_label("Phase 2: 2...Nc6  3.Bb5 — The Spanish Bishop")
        self.play(Write(lbl2), run_time=0.5)

        pgn_phase2 = """3. Nc3 Nc6 4. Bb5"""
        moves2 = convert_from_PGN(pgn_phase2, FEN=FEN2)
        play_game(scene=self, board=board, moves=moves2, animation_time=0.6)
        self.wait(0.4)
        self.play(FadeOut(lbl2), run_time=0.3)

        # ── Annotation: highlight the pin ─────────────────────────────────────
        lbl3 = phase_label("Bb5 pins the Nc6, indirectly attacking e5", color="#60a5fa")
        self.play(Write(lbl3), run_time=0.6)
        self.wait(1.0)
        self.play(FadeOut(lbl3), run_time=0.4)

        # ── Opening summary panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────
        summary_items = VGroup(
            Text("Opening: Ruy López (C60–C99)", font_size=15, color="#e2e8f0"),
            Text("Key idea: Pin Nc6, pressure e5", font_size=15, color="#e2e8f0"),
            Text("Played since 1560 by Ruy López de Segura", font_size=15, color="#64748b"),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        panel_box = SurroundingRectangle(summary_items, color="#334155", buff=0.18, corner_radius=0.08)
        panel = VGroup(panel_box, summary_items)
        panel.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.25).shift(DOWN * 0.3)

        self.play(FadeIn(panel, shift=LEFT * 0.3), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(1.5)

"""
RAG Scene 03 — Chess: Annotated tactics — fork, pin, skewer
Feature: draw_arrow, mark_square, highlight_square, remove_arrows
"""
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board

class ChessTacticsAnnotationScene(Scene):
    """
    Demonstrates three classic chess tactics — Knight fork, Bishop pin, and
    Rook skewer — using Board.draw_arrow, mark_square, and highlight_square.
    Each tactic is introduced with a native Manim title card, arrow overlay,
    and a VGroup annotation panel that fades in at the side.
    """

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#111827"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Chess Tactics: Fork · Pin · Skewer", font_size=34, color=WHITE)
        subtitle = Text("Visualized with arrow and square annotations", font_size=18, color="#6b7280")
        header = VGroup(title, subtitle).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.6)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Helper: side annotation panel ─────────────────────────────────
        def make_panel(lines, colors=None):
            if colors is None:
                colors = ["#e2e8f0"] * len(lines)
            items = VGroup(*[
                Text(t, font_size=15, color=c) for t, c in zip(lines, colors)
            ]).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.14, aligned_edge=LEFT)
            box = SurroundingRectangle(items, color="#374151", buff=0.16, corner_radius=0.08)
            return VGroup(box, items)

        # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        tactic1_label = Text("Tactic 1: Knight Fork", font_size=26, color="#f59e0b")

        self.play(FadeIn(tactic1_label, shift=DOWN * 0.15), run_time=0.6)

        board1.draw_arrow("e5", "g6")

        board1.highlight_square("c6")

        panel1 = make_panel(
            ["Knight on e5", "Attacks king on g6", "AND queen on c6", "→ Win the queen!"],
            ["#fbbf24", "#f87171", "#f87171", "#34d399"]

        panel1.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.3).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(panel1, shift=LEFT * 0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1.2)

        self.play(FadeOut(board1), FadeOut(tactic1_label), FadeOut(panel1), run_time=0.5)

        # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # TACTIC 2: BISHOP PIN
        # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        tactic2_label = Text("Tactic 2: Bishop Pin", font_size=26, color="#60a5fa")
        tactic2_label.next_to(header, DOWN, buff=0.35)

        board2.set_board_from_FEN(FEN_PIN)

        self.play(FadeIn(board2), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(0.3)

        board2.draw_arrow("b3", "g8")
        board2.highlight_square("d5")
        board2.mark_square("b3")
        self.wait(0.3)

        panel2 = make_panel(
            ["Bishop on b3", "Pins knight on d5", "to king on g8", "Nd5 cannot move!"],
            ["#60a5fa", "#fbbf24", "#6b7280", "#34d399"]
        )
        panel2.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.3).shift(DOWN * 0.5)
        self.play(FadeIn(panel2, shift=LEFT * 0.2), run_time=0.8)
        self.wait(1.2)

        self.play(FadeOut(board2), FadeOut(tactic2_label), FadeOut(panel2), run_time=0.5)

        # ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        # TACTIC 3: ROOK SKEWER

"""
RAG Scene 04 — Chess: Evaluation bar showing game swings
Feature: EvaluationBar.set_evaluation, Board, play_game, annotated eval swings
"""
from manim import *
from manim_chess import Board, EvaluationBar, play_game, convert_from_PGN

class ChessEvalBarScene(Scene):
    """
    Shows a short game fragment with a live evaluation bar on the left side.
    After each pair of moves the evaluation changes, animating the bar with
    self.play(*eval_bar.set_evaluation(x)).  Native Manim annotations — a
    Text eval label, Transform, and a SurroundingRectangle status panel —
    complement the chess-specific visualisation.
    """

    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#0f0f1a"

        # ── Title ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        title = Text("Chess Engine Evaluation", font_size=36, color=WHITE)
        subtitle = Text("Watch the advantage swing with each move", font_size=18, color="#8b949e")
        header = VGroup(title, subtitle).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.15)
        header.to_edge(UP, buff=0.35)

        self.play(Write(title), run_time=1.0)
        self.play(FadeIn(subtitle, shift=UP * 0.2), run_time=0.6)
        self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Board + Eval bar ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        FEN = "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1"
        board = Board()
        board.set_board_from_FEN(FEN)
        board.scale(0.85).move_to(ORIGIN + DOWN * 0.25 + RIGHT * 0.4)

        eval_bar = EvaluationBar(evaluation=0.0)
        eval_bar.move_to(board.get_left()).shift(LEFT * 0.55)

        self.play(FadeIn(board), FadeIn(eval_bar), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.4)

        # ── Eval label next to bar ─────────────────────────────────────────
        eval_text = Text("0.0", font_size=20, color="#e2e8f0")
        eval_text.next_to(eval_bar, DOWN, buff=0.25)
        self.play(FadeIn(eval_text), run_time=0.3)

        # ── Helper: update eval label and bar together ─────────────────────
        def update_eval(val):
            new_lbl = Text(f"{val:+.1f}", font_size=20, color="#34d399" if val > 0 else "#f87171")
            new_lbl.next_to(eval_bar, DOWN, buff=0.25)
            self.play(
                *eval_bar.set_evaluation(val),
                Transform(eval_text, new_lbl),
                run_time=0.9
            )
            self.wait(0.3)

        # ── Move sequence (4 plies each phase) ────────────────────────────
        phase_lbl = Text("1. e4 e5  2. Nf3 Nc6  — Equal opening", font_size=18, color="#9ca3af")
        phase_lbl.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.35)
        self.play(Write(phase_lbl), run_time=0.5)

        pgn1 = "1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6"
        moves1 = convert_from_PGN(pgn1, FEN=FEN)
        play_game(scene=self, board=board, moves=moves1, animation_time=0.5)
        update_eval(0.3)
        self.play(FadeOut(phase_lbl), run_time=0.3)

        FEN2 = "r1bqkbnr/pppp1ppp/2n5/4p3/4P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKB1R w KQkq - 2 3"

        phase_lbl2 = Text("3. d3?! d5  4. exd5 Qxd5 — Black advantage", font_size=18, color="#f87171")
        phase_lbl2.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.35)
        self.play(Write(phase_lbl2), run_time=0.5)

        pgn2 = "3. d3 d5 4. exd5 Qxd5"
        moves2 = convert_from_PGN(pgn2, FEN=FEN2)
        play_game(scene=self, board=board, moves=moves2, animation_time=0.5)
        update_eval(-1.4)
        self.play(FadeOut(phase_lbl2), run_time=0.3)

        FEN3 = "r1b1kbnr/ppp2ppp/2n5/3qp3/3PP3/8/PPP2PPP/RNBQKB1R w KQkq - 0 5"

        phase_lbl3 = Text("5. Nc3 Qd6  6. Be3 — White recovers", font_size=18, color="#34d399")
        phase_lbl3.to_edge(DOWN, buff=0.35)
        self.play(Write(phase_lbl3), run_time=0.5)

        pgn3 = "5. Nc3 Qd6"
        moves3 = convert_from_PGN(pgn3, FEN=FEN3)
        play_game(scene=self, board=board, moves=moves3, animation_time=0.5)
        update_eval(0.1)
        self.play(FadeOut(phase_lbl3), run_time=0.3)

        # ── Final status panel ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
        status_lines = VGroup(
            Text("Game Status", font_size=18, color="#f9fafb"),
            Text("Material: Equal", font_size=15, color="#9ca3af"),
            Text("White has slight edge", font_size=15, color="#34d399"),
            Text("Engine eval: +0.1", font_size=15, color="#34d399"),
        ).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.14, aligned_edge=LEFT)
        status_box = SurroundingRectangle(status_lines, color="#1f2937", buff=0.18, corner_radius=0.1)
        status_panel = VGroup(status_box, status_lines)
        status_panel.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.2).shift(UP * 0.5)

        self.play(FadeIn(status_panel, shift=LEFT * 0.3), run_time=0.9)
        self.wait(1.5)
